"""Ridge panels sharing numeric domains, group order and series colors."""

import math

from .._typography import chart_font_sizes
from ._distribution import (
    Canvas,
    _derive_series_colors,
    _resolve_palette,
    _rgba_with_alpha,
    _xesc,
    axis_ticks,
    draw_header,
    finite,
    header_height,
    kde,
    legend_layout,
    measure,
    normalize_groups,
    quantile,
    sample_domain,
    sample_stats,
    value_scale,
    wrap,
)

VARIANTS = ("default_flat", "outlined_separated", "gradient_overlap", "joy_division", "histogram_binned")


def render_ridge(
    distributions,
    group_labels=None,
    x_range=None,
    *,
    conditions=None,
    variant=None,
    title=None,
    subtitle=None,
    x_unit=None,
    x_labels=None,
    academic=False,
    highlight_index=None,
    multi_mode="single",
    width=900,
    height=None,
    palette=None,
    font_family=None,
):
    """Named rows contain samples."""
    if variant not in (None, "classic", *VARIANTS):
        raise ValueError(f"unknown ridge variant {variant!r}")
    if multi_mode not in (None, "auto", "single", "off", "with_condition_facets", "with_counts", "with_median_trend"):
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported ridge multi_mode {multi_mode!r}")
    if multi_mode == "with_condition_facets" and conditions is None:
        raise ValueError("with_condition_facets requires conditions")
    if x_range is not None and (len(x_range) != 2 or finite(x_range[1], "x_range") <= finite(x_range[0], "x_range")):
        raise ValueError("x_range must contain two increasing finite numbers")
    inputs = conditions if conditions is not None else [(None, distributions)]
    normalized = []
    all_sample_groups = []
    order = []
    series_order = []
    for facet_name, rows in inputs:
        if not rows:
            raise ValueError("ridge requires nonempty distributions")
        if group_labels is not None and len(group_labels) != len(rows):
            raise ValueError("group_labels length must match distribution rows")
        named = all(isinstance(row, (tuple, list)) and len(row) == 2 and isinstance(row[0], str) for row in rows)
        panel = []
        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            if named:
                name = str(group_labels[i]) if group_labels is not None else str(row[0])
                payload = row[1]
                series = payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {"": payload}
                row_series = []
                for label, values in series.items():
                    sample = normalize_groups([(name, values)])[0]
                    all_sample_groups.append(sample)
                    row_series.append((str(label), sample))
                    if str(label) not in series_order:
                        series_order.append(str(label))
                if not row_series:
                    raise ValueError("grouped ridge requires at least one series")
                panel.append((name, row_series, None))
            else:
                name = str(group_labels[i]) if group_labels is not None else f"Group {i + 1}"
                density = [finite(value, "density") for value in row]
                if len(density) < 2 or any(value < 0 for value in density) or max(density) <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("density rows need at least two nonnegative ordinates and a positive peak")
                panel.append((name, [], density))
        if group_labels is not None and len(group_labels) != len(panel):
            raise ValueError("group_labels length must match distribution rows")
        names = [row[0] for row in panel]
        if len(set(names)) != len(names):
            raise ValueError("ridge row names must be unique")
        if not order:
            order = names
        elif set(names) != set(order):
            raise ValueError("ridge facets must contain the same row names")
        panel.sort(key=lambda row: order.index(row[0]))
        normalized.append((str(facet_name) if facet_name is not None else None, panel))
    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError("ridge requires at least one panel")
    if all_sample_groups:
        domain = sample_domain(all_sample_groups, *(x_range or (None, None)), density=True)
    elif x_range is not None:
        domain = tuple(finite(value, "x_range") for value in x_range)
        if len(domain) != 2 or domain[1] <= domain[0]:
            raise ValueError("x_range must contain two increasing finite numbers")
    else:
        domain = (0, len(normalized[0][1][0][2]) - 1)
    if variant == "histogram_binned" and not all_sample_groups:
        raise ValueError("histogram_binned requires raw samples, not precomputed densities")
    if multi_mode == "with_median_trend" and not all_sample_groups:
        raise ValueError("with_median_trend requires raw samples")
    if multi_mode == "with_counts" and not all_sample_groups:
        raise ValueError("with_counts requires raw samples")
    if multi_mode == "auto":
        multi_mode = (
            "with_median_trend"
            if conditions is None
            and len(order) >= 5
            and all(len(series) == 1 and len(series[0][1].values) >= 5 for _, series, _ in normalized[0][1])
            else "single"
        )
    series_order.sort()
    grouped = len(series_order) > 1
    width = finite(900 if width is None else width, "width")
    cols = min(len(normalized), max(1, int(width // 470)))
    rows = math.ceil(len(normalized) / cols)
    gap = 34
    cell_w = (width - 64 - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols
    fonts = chart_font_sizes(cell_w, (height or width * 0.7) / rows, max(len(order), len(series_order)))
    fs, tick_fs, axis_fs = fonts["group"], fonts["xtick"], fonts["xaxis"]
    legend_fs, count_fs, facet_fs = fonts["legend"], fonts["group_n"], fonts["subtitle"]
    header_fonts = chart_font_sizes(width, height or width * 0.7, len(order))
    left = min(cell_w * 0.34, max(88, max(measure(label, fs) for label in order) + 28))
    label_lines = {label: wrap(label, left - 20, fs) for label in order}
    label_block = max(len(lines) for lines in label_lines.values()) * fs * 1.35 + (count_fs * 1.35 if academic else 0)
    row_step = max(58, label_block + 12)
    # Ridges overlap by design; a caller-fixed height may compress the pitch to the label block.
    min_row_step = label_block + 2
    if variant == "joy_division" and palette is None:
        palette = "nightlab"
    resolved_palette = _resolve_palette(palette)
    colors = _derive_series_colors(resolved_palette, len(series_order) if grouped else len(order), mode="distinct")
    dash_patterns = ("", "4 3", "1 2", "6 2 1 2", "6 2 1 2 1 2", "2 2 6 2", "7 2 3 2", "3 2 1 2")
    series_styles = {}
    for index, label in enumerate(series_order):
        pattern = dash_patterns[index] if index < len(dash_patterns) else f"{10 + index} 3 1 3"
        series_styles[label] = (
            resolved_palette["ink"] if variant == "joy_division" else colors[index],
            f'stroke-dasharray="{pattern}"' if pattern else "",
        )
    legend_items = (
        [
            (
                label,
                series_styles[label][0],
                series_styles[label][1] + f' data-role="series-legend" data-series="{_xesc(label)}"',
            )
            for label in series_order
        ]
        if grouped
        else []
    )
    legend_rows, legend_h = legend_layout(legend_items, width, legend_fs)
    if x_labels is not None and len(x_labels) < 2:
        raise ValueError("x_labels requires at least two labels")
    tick_values, tick_labels, offset_label = axis_ticks(domain, len(x_labels) if x_labels else 5)
    if x_labels is not None:
        if len(x_labels) < 2:
            raise ValueError("x_labels requires at least two labels")
        tick_labels = [str(label) for label in x_labels]
    count_w = (
        max(108, measure("Total sample" if grouped else "Sample count", count_fs) + 24)
        if multi_mode == "with_counts"
        else 0
    )
    right_margin = max(12, max(measure(label, tick_fs) for label in tick_labels) / 2 + 4)
    plot_width = cell_w - left - right_margin - count_w
    if plot_width < 100:
        raise ValueError("ridge panel too narrow; increase width")
    axis_lines = wrap(x_unit, plot_width, axis_fs) if x_unit else []
    tick_lines = [
        wrap(label, max(32, plot_width / max(1, len(tick_labels) - 1) * 0.9), tick_fs) for label in tick_labels
    ]
    axis_h = max(len(lines) for lines in tick_lines) * tick_fs * 1.35 + len(axis_lines) * axis_fs * 1.35 + 24
    top = header_height(width, title, subtitle, fonts=header_fonts) + legend_h + 16
    trend_row_h = max(36, max(len(lines) for lines in label_lines.values()) * fs * 1.35 + 12)
    trend_h = facet_fs * 1.35 + 26 + len(order) * trend_row_h + axis_h if multi_mode == "with_median_trend" else 0
    facet_header = max(
        [len(wrap(name, cell_w, facet_fs)) * facet_fs * 1.35 + 15 for name, _ in normalized if name] or [36]
    )
    facet_header += count_fs * 1.35 + 8 if offset_label else 0
    if count_w:
        facet_header = max(facet_header, count_fs * 3.7)
    cell_min = facet_header + len(order) * row_step + axis_h + trend_h
    min_height = top + rows * cell_min + (rows - 1) * gap + 20
    if height is not None:
        trend_row_h = max(len(lines) for lines in label_lines.values()) * fs * 1.35 + 2
        trend_h = facet_fs * 1.35 + 26 + len(order) * trend_row_h + axis_h if trend_h else 0
        cell_min = facet_header + len(order) * min_row_step + axis_h + trend_h
        min_height = top + rows * cell_min + (rows - 1) * gap + 20
    height = min_height if height is None else finite(height, "height")
    if height < min_height:
        raise ValueError(f"ridge height must be at least {math.ceil(min_height)}")
    cell_h = (height - top - 20 - (rows - 1) * gap) / rows
    if variant == "joy_division" and palette is None:
        palette = "nightlab"
    c = Canvas(width, height, palette, font_family)
    draw_header(c, title, subtitle, fonts=header_fonts)
    colors = _derive_series_colors(c.pal, len(series_order) if grouped else len(order), mode="distinct")
    for x, y, lines, color, extra in legend_rows:
        c.line(x, top - legend_h + y - 6, x + 18, top - legend_h + y - 6, color, 2, extra)
        c.lines(x + 24, top - legend_h + y - 2, lines, legend_fs, color=c.muted)
    # Compute densities once; this also provides a common density-height scale.
    curves = {}
    for f, (_, panel) in enumerate(normalized):
        for i, (_, series, density) in enumerate(panel):
            if density is not None:
                xs = [domain[0] + (domain[1] - domain[0]) * j / (len(density) - 1) for j in range(len(density))]
                curves[f, i, 0] = (xs, density)
            else:
                for j, (_, sample) in enumerate(series):
                    if variant == "histogram_binned":
                        bins = max(8, min(28, int(math.sqrt(len(sample.values)))))
                        step = (domain[1] - domain[0]) / bins
                        counts = [0] * bins
                        for value in sample.values:
                            counts[min(bins - 1, int((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0]) * bins))] += 1
                        xs = [domain[0] + k * step for k in range(bins + 1)]
                        ys = [count * bins / len(sample.values) for count in counts]
                        curves[f, i, j] = (xs, ys)
                    else:
                        curves[f, i, j] = kde(sample.values, domain)
    peak = max(max(curve[1]) for curve in curves.values())
    max_n = max(
        (sum(len(sample.values) for _, sample in series) for _, panel in normalized for _, series, _ in panel),
        default=1,
    )
    for f, (name, panel) in enumerate(normalized):
        cx = 32 + (f % cols) * (cell_w + gap)
        cy = top + (f // cols) * (cell_h + gap)
        if name:
            c.lines(cx, cy + facet_fs, wrap(name, cell_w, facet_fs), facet_fs, weight=600)
        pl = cx + left
        pr = cx + cell_w - right_margin - count_w
        if pr - pl < 100:
            raise ValueError("ridge panel too narrow; increase width")
        pt = cy + facet_header
        pb = cy + cell_h - axis_h - trend_h
        step = (pb - pt) / len(order)
        scale = value_scale(domain, pl, pr)
        if offset_label:
            c.text(pl, pt - 9, offset_label, count_fs, color=c.muted)
        for value, lines in zip(tick_values, tick_lines):
            x = scale(value)
            c.line(x, pt, x, pb, c.grid, 0.7)
            c.lines(x, pb + tick_fs + 10, lines, tick_fs, "middle", c.muted)
        if axis_lines:
            c.lines(
                (pl + pr) / 2,
                pb + 10 + max(len(lines) for lines in tick_lines) * tick_fs * 1.35 + axis_fs,
                axis_lines,
                axis_fs,
                "middle",
                c.muted,
            )
        if count_w:
            count_title = "Total sample count" if grouped else "Sample count"
            count_lines = wrap(count_title, count_w - 20, count_fs)
            c.lines(
                pr + count_w / 2 + 8,
                pt - 12 - (len(count_lines) - 1) * count_fs * 1.35,
                count_lines,
                count_fs,
                "middle",
                c.muted,
            )
        medians = []
        for i, (label, series, density) in enumerate(panel):
            base = pt + (i + 0.92) * step
            lines = label_lines[label]
            block_h = len(lines) * fs * 1.35 + (count_fs * 1.35 if academic and series else 0)
            label_y = pt + (i + 0.5) * step - block_h / 2 + fs
            c.lines(pl - 14, label_y, lines, fs, "end", weight=600 if i == highlight_index else 400)
            if academic and series:
                c.text(
                    pl - 14,
                    label_y + len(lines) * fs * 1.35,
                    f"n = {sum(len(s.values) for _, s in series)}",
                    count_fs,
                    "end",
                    c.muted,
                )
            c.line(pl, base, pr, base, c.grid, 0.8)
            for j in range(len(series) or 1):
                series_name = series[j][0] if series else ""
                color, dash = (
                    series_styles[series_name] if grouped else (c.ink if variant == "joy_division" else colors[i], "")
                )
                xs, ys = curves[f, i, j]
                amplitude = step * 0.77
                if variant == "histogram_binned":
                    points = [(scale(xs[0]), base)]
                    for k, value in enumerate(ys):
                        points.extend(
                            (
                                (scale(xs[k]), base - value / peak * amplitude),
                                (scale(xs[k + 1]), base - value / peak * amplitude),
                            )
                        )
                    points.append((scale(xs[-1]), base))
                else:
                    points = (
                        [(pl, base)] + [(scale(x), base - y / peak * amplitude) for x, y in zip(xs, ys)] + [(pr, base)]
                    )
                fill = (
                    "none"
                    if variant in ("outlined_separated", "joy_division")
                    else _rgba_with_alpha(color, 0.18 if grouped else 0.27)
                )
                if variant == "gradient_overlap":
                    gradient_id = f"ridge-gradient-{f}-{i}-{j}"
                    c.parts.append(
                        f'<defs><linearGradient id="{gradient_id}" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="{color}" stop-opacity="0.60"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="{color}" stop-opacity="0.08"/></linearGradient></defs>'
                    )
                    fill = f"url(#{gradient_id})"
                c.path(
                    points,
                    color,
                    fill,
                    2 if i == highlight_index else 1.5,
                    True,
                    f'{dash} data-role="ridge-density" data-input-kind="{"samples" if series else "density"}" data-group="{_xesc(label)}" data-series="{_xesc(series_name)}"',
                )
                if academic and series:
                    median = quantile(series[j][1].values, 0.5)
                    c.line(scale(median), base, scale(median), base - 10, color, 2)
            if series:
                samples = [v for _, sample in series for v in sample.values]
                medians.append(sample_stats(samples))
                if count_w:
                    count = len(samples)
                    c.line(
                        pr + 20,
                        base - 15,
                        pr + 20 + (count_w - 54) * count / max_n,
                        base - 15,
                        c.muted if grouped else colors[i % len(colors)],
                        8,
                        f'data-role="sample-count" data-count="{count}"',
                    )
                    c.text(pr + count_w - 5, base - 11, str(count), count_fs, "end", c.muted)
        if trend_h:
            trend_title_y = pb + axis_h + facet_fs
            c.text(
                pl,
                trend_title_y,
                "Group median and IQR" if not grouped else "Pooled group median and IQR",
                facet_fs,
                weight=600,
            )
            trend_top = trend_title_y + 16
            trend_bottom = trend_top + len(order) * trend_row_h
            for value, lines in zip(tick_values, tick_lines):
                x = scale(value)
                c.line(x, trend_top, x, trend_bottom, c.grid, 0.7)
                c.lines(x, trend_bottom + tick_fs + 10, lines, tick_fs, "middle", c.muted)
            points = []
            for i, (label, stats) in enumerate(zip(order, medians)):
                cy_trend = trend_top + (i + 0.5) * trend_row_h
                lines = label_lines[label]
                c.lines(pl - 14, cy_trend - (len(lines) - 1) * fs * 0.675 + fs * 0.33, lines, fs, "end")
                color = c.ink if grouped else colors[i]
                c.line(scale(stats["q1"]), cy_trend, scale(stats["q3"]), cy_trend, color, 2.4)
                points.append((scale(stats["median"]), cy_trend))
                c.circle(
                    scale(stats["median"]),
                    cy_trend,
                    3.2,
                    color,
                    f'data-role="ridge-median" data-group="{_xesc(label)}" data-value="{stats["median"]:.17g}"',
                )
            c.path(points, c.muted, stroke=1)
            if axis_lines:
                c.lines(
                    (pl + pr) / 2,
                    trend_bottom + 10 + max(len(lines) for lines in tick_lines) * tick_fs * 1.35 + axis_fs,
                    axis_lines,
                    axis_fs,
                    "middle",
                    c.muted,
                )
    return c.svg()

"""Liver microanatomy: hepatic stellate cell / myofibroblast (``cell(kind=...)``) and the sinusoid section ``liver_sinusoid``."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import random

from ..atomize_svg_to_slide._geometry import fmt
from ._bio_parts import _el, _look, _mix, _radial, _smooth, _circ, _check_style, _finish, _ellipse_d
from ._geometry import Box, _finite
from ._help import _drawing_api

_LIPID = "#F2D16B"
_COLLAGEN = "#C2542E"


def _taper_d(spine, w0, w1):
    left, right = [], []
    n = len(spine)
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(spine):
        a, b = spine[max(0, i - 1)], spine[min(n - 1, i + 1)]
        tx, ty = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
        L = math.hypot(tx, ty) or 1
        w = (w0 + (w1 - w0) * i / (n - 1)) / 2
        left.append((x - ty / L * w, y + tx / L * w))
        right.append((x + ty / L * w, y - tx / L * w))
    return _smooth(left + right[::-1], closed=True)


def _wavy(x0, y0, x1, y1, amp, waves, phase=0.0, n=28):
    L = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) or 1
    ux, uy = (x1 - x0) / L, (y1 - y0) / L
    pts = [
        (
            x0 + ux * L * t / n - uy * amp * math.sin(2 * math.pi * waves * t / n + phase),
            y0 + uy * L * t / n + ux * amp * math.sin(2 * math.pi * waves * t / n + phase),
        )
        for t in range(n + 1)
    ]
    return _smooth(pts)


def _fibre_bundle(x0, y0, x1, y1, w, color, k, sw):
    """Banded collagen fibre bundle: several wavy fibrils with D-period cross-banding."""
    d = []
    for j in range(k):
        off = (j - (k - 1) / 2) * w / max(1, k - 1) if k > 1 else 0
        L = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) or 1
        nx, ny = -(y1 - y0) / L, (x1 - x0) / L
        d.append(_wavy(x0 + nx * off, y0 + ny * off, x1 + nx * off, y1 + ny * off, w * 0.18, 2.2, phase=j * 0.9))
    return _el("path", d=" ".join(d), fill="none", stroke=color, stroke_width=sw, stroke_linecap="round")


def _stellate_parts(cx, cy, rx, ry, *, activated, fill, membrane, rich, seed, angle=0.0, band=None):
    """Elements + bound points + ports for a stellate cell centred at (cx, cy) with long axis along ``angle`` (rad)."""
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    els, look, pts, ports = [], [], [], {}
    m = min(rx, ry)
    ca, sa = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    P = lambda u, v: (cx + u * ca - v * sa, cy + u * sa + v * ca)
    if not activated:
        # quiescent: small body with long, thin, branched processes that wrap the sinusoid (pericyte-like)
        body = []
        for i in range(48):
            a = 2 * math.pi * i / 48
            k = 1 + 0.06 * math.sin(3 * a + seed)
            body.append(P(rx * 0.55 * k * math.cos(a), ry * 0.62 * k * math.sin(a)))
        proc = []
        if band:
            # flattened in the space of Disse: long processes run along the sinusoid, a short one wraps the endothelium
            dirs = [(math.pi + 0.06, 2.6), (-0.05, 2.4), (math.pi - 0.1, 1.6), (0.12, 1.7)]
        else:
            dirs = [(2 * math.pi * (i + 0.3 + rnd.uniform(-0.12, 0.12)) / 5, rnd.uniform(1.1, 1.55)) for i in range(5)]
        for i, (a, Lk) in enumerate(dirs):
            sp, ang = [P(rx * 0.42 * math.cos(a), ry * 0.45 * math.sin(a))], a
            L = rx * Lk
            for j in range(10):
                ang += rnd.uniform(-0.16, 0.16) if not band else 0
                u = rx * 0.42 * math.cos(a) + math.cos(ang) * L * (j + 1) / 10
                v = ry * 0.45 * math.sin(a) + math.sin(ang) * L * (j + 1) / 10
                if band:
                    v = max(-band * 0.7, min(band * 0.7, v + band * 0.18 * math.sin(j * 0.9 + i)))
                sp.append(P(u, v))
            proc.append(_taper_d(sp, m * 0.3, m * 0.06))
            pts += sp
            ports[f"process{i}"] = sp[-1]
            if band:
                continue
            b0 = sp[5]
            ba = ang + rnd.choice((-1, 1)) * 0.8
            sp2 = [b0] + [
                (b0[0] + math.cos(ba + angle) * L * 0.35 * t / 4, b0[1] + math.sin(ba + angle) * L * 0.35 * t / 4)
                for t in range(1, 5)
            ]
            proc.append(_taper_d(sp2, m * 0.14, m * 0.04))
            pts += sp2
        els.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=_smooth(body, closed=True),
                fill=fill,
                stroke=membrane,
                stroke_width=max(1.0, m * 0.05),
                data_outline="1",
            )
        )
        els.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=" ".join(proc),
                fill=fill,
                stroke=membrane,
                stroke_width=max(0.8, m * 0.04),
                stroke_linejoin="round",
            )
        )
        els.append(_el("path", d=_smooth(body, closed=True), fill=fill))
        # nucleus pushed aside / indented by the lipid droplets
        nc = P(-rx * 0.18, ry * 0.1)
        els.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=_ellipse_d(nc[0], nc[1], rx * 0.22, ry * 0.2, math.degrees(angle)),
                fill=_mix(membrane, "#FFFFFF", 0.55),
                stroke=_mix(membrane, "#000000", 0.2),
                stroke_width=1,
            )
        )
        drops = [(0.2, -0.22, 0.17), (0.32, 0.12, 0.15), (0.08, 0.3, 0.12), (-0.02, -0.35, 0.11), (0.42, -0.12, 0.1)]
        dd = []
        for u, v, r in drops:
            x, y = P(rx * u, ry * v)
            dd.append(_circ(x, y, m * r))
        els.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=" ".join(dd),
                fill=_LIPID,
                stroke=_mix(_LIPID, "#7A5A10", 0.5),
                stroke_width=max(0.6, m * 0.025),
            )
        )
        if rich:
            hl = [_circ(*P(rx * u - m * r * 0.3, ry * v - m * r * 0.3), m * r * 0.32) for u, v, r in drops]
            look.append(_el("path", d=" ".join(hl), fill="#FFFFFF", fill_opacity=0.6))
        ports.update(nucleus=nc, lipid=P(rx * 0.2, -ry * 0.22))
        pts += body
    else:
        # activated myofibroblast: elongated spindle, lipid droplets lost, stress fibres, secreted collagen
        spine = [P(-rx * 1.0 + 2 * rx * t / 20, ry * 0.08 * math.sin(math.pi * t / 20 * 2 + seed)) for t in range(21)]
        prof = [ry * (0.16 + 0.84 * math.sin(math.pi * t / 20) ** 1.2) for t in range(21)]
        left, right = [], []
        for i, (x, y) in enumerate(spine):
            a, b = spine[max(0, i - 1)], spine[min(20, i + 1)]
            tx, ty = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
            L = math.hypot(tx, ty) or 1
            w = prof[i] * (1.08 if i % 5 == 2 else 1)
            left.append((x - ty / L * w, y + tx / L * w))
            right.append((x + ty / L * w * 0.9, y - tx / L * w * 0.9))
        body = left + right[::-1]
        # short lamellipodia / processes at both poles
        poles = []
        for sgn, base in ((-1, spine[0]), (1, spine[-1])):
            inner = spine[3] if sgn < 0 else spine[-4]
            for dv in (-0.2, 0.24):
                a0 = angle + (math.pi if sgn < 0 else 0) + dv
                sp = [inner] + [
                    (
                        base[0] + math.cos(a0) * rx * 0.34 * t / 5,
                        base[1] + math.sin(a0) * rx * 0.34 * t / 5 + dv * ry * 0.4 * t / 5,
                    )
                    for t in range(1, 6)
                ]
                poles.append(_taper_d(sp, ry * 0.3, ry * 0.05))
                pts += sp
        els.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=_smooth(body, closed=True),
                fill=fill,
                stroke=membrane,
                stroke_width=max(1.0, m * 0.05),
                data_outline="1",
            )
        )
        els.append(_el("path", d=" ".join(poles), fill=fill, stroke=membrane, stroke_width=max(0.8, m * 0.04)))
        els.append(_el("path", d=_smooth(body, closed=True), fill=fill))
        # stress fibres: parallel actin cables along the long axis (α-SMA)
        sf = []
        for j in range(5):
            v = (j - 2) * ry * 0.17
            a0, a1 = P(-rx * 0.78, v * 0.7), P(rx * 0.78, v * 0.7)
            mid = P(0, v)
            sf.append(f"M{fmt(a0[0])} {fmt(a0[1])} Q{fmt(mid[0])} {fmt(mid[1])} {fmt(a1[0])} {fmt(a1[1])}")
        sf_c = "#B23A48"
        els.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=" ".join(sf),
                fill="none",
                stroke=sf_c,
                stroke_width=max(0.7, m * 0.045),
                stroke_opacity=0.85,
                stroke_linecap="round",
            )
        )
        nc = P(rx * 0.05, 0)
        els.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=_ellipse_d(nc[0], nc[1], rx * 0.3, ry * 0.3, math.degrees(angle)),
                fill=_mix(membrane, "#FFFFFF", 0.55),
                stroke=_mix(membrane, "#000000", 0.2),
                stroke_width=1,
            )
        )
        els.append(
            _el(
                "ellipse",
                cx=nc[0] + rx * 0.08 * ca,
                cy=nc[1] + rx * 0.08 * sa,
                rx=m * 0.09,
                ry=m * 0.08,
                fill=_mix(membrane, "#000000", 0.25),
            )
        )
        # secreted collagen bundles running alongside the cell
        cols = []
        for v, w in ((ry * 1.3, ry * 0.45), (-ry * 1.25, ry * 0.38)):
            a0, a1 = P(-rx * 1.15, v), P(rx * 1.15, v)
            cols.append(_fibre_bundle(a0[0], a0[1], a1[0], a1[1], w, _COLLAGEN, 4, max(1.0, m * 0.07)))
            pts += [P(-rx * 1.15, v + w), P(rx * 1.15, v - w)]
        els.extend(cols)
        ports.update(nucleus=nc, stress_fiber=P(-rx * 0.45, ry * 0.17), collagen=P(rx * 0.6, ry * 1.35))
        pts += body
    if rich:
        look.insert(0, _el("path", d=els[0].get("d"), fill="#FFFFFF", fill_opacity=0.18))
    return els, look, pts, ports


def _stellate_cell(rx, ry, *, activated, fill, membrane, style, seed):
    rich = _check_style(style)
    ry = (rx * (0.42 if activated else 0.9)) if ry is None or ry == rx else ry
    _finite(rx, ry)
    holder, defs = _el("g"), _el("defs")
    holder.append(defs)
    els, look, pts, ports = _stellate_parts(
        0, 0, rx, ry, activated=activated, fill=fill, membrane=membrane, rich=rich, seed=seed
    )
    holder.extend(els)
    if rich and look:
        g = _look()
        g.extend(look)
        holder.append(g)
    xs, ys = [p[0] for p in pts], [p[1] for p in pts]
    pad = 2
    return _finish(
        holder,
        defs,
        Box(min(xs) - pad, min(ys) - pad, max(xs) - min(xs) + 2 * pad, max(ys) - min(ys) + 2 * pad),
        **ports,
    )


@_drawing_api(
    "parts",
    purpose="肝窦纵切（教科书级）：窦腔（红细胞）、带窗孔的扁平内皮、Disse 间隙（微绒毛伸入）、两侧肝细胞板（带核、胆小管）、窦腔内 Kupffer 细胞、Disse 间隙内的肝星状细胞（静息：脂滴+细长突起；活化：肌成纤维细胞+应力纤维），fibrosis 时 Disse 间隙沉积胶原、内皮窗孔消失（毛细血管化）。",
    returns="Geometry（原点在中心；端口 lumen/endothelium/fenestra/disse/hepatocyte/hepatocyte2/bile_canaliculus/kupffer/stellate/collagen/rbc0…/inflow/outflow）",
    semantics=(
        "width 为长度（高≈0.62×宽）；血流自左向右（inflow → outflow，门管区 → 中央静脉）。",
        'stellate="quiescent"（默认）或 "activated"；fibrosis=0–1 为 Disse 间隙胶原沉积程度（>0 时窗孔按比例减少，≥0.5 内皮下出现基底膜）。',
        "kupffer=True 在窦腔内画 Kupffer 细胞（贴内皮的巨噬细胞，含吞噬泡）；cells 为每侧肝细胞数（2–6）。",
        '不写文字：用 d.callout("hsc", "肝星状细胞", s.port("stellate"), at=(...)) 标注；style="flat" 全原生。',
    ),
    example='s = d.place(liver_sinusoid(520, stellate="activated", fibrosis=.6), at=(480, 300), key="sin")\n'
    'd.callout("hsc", "活化 HSC", s.port("stellate"), at=(860, 470), font_size=13)\n'
    'd.callout("kc", "Kupffer 细胞", s.port("kupffer"), at=(110, 90), font_size=13)',
    rank=31,
)
def liver_sinusoid(
    width=560,
    *,
    stellate="quiescent",
    fibrosis=0.0,
    kupffer=True,
    cells=4,
    hepatocyte="#E9B9A0",
    endothelium="#C98C8C",
    blood="#C8323C",
    stellate_color="#E8DDB8",
    style="rich",
    seed=3,
):
    rich = _check_style(style)
    _finite(width, fibrosis)
    if stellate not in ("quiescent", "activated"):
        raise ValueError('stellate must be "quiescent" or "activated"')
    if not 2 <= int(cells) <= 6:
        raise ValueError("cells must be 2..6 hepatocytes per plate")
    fibrosis = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(fibrosis)))
    cells = int(cells)
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    W = float(width)
    H = W * 0.62
    s = W / 560.0
    holder, defs = _el("g"), _el("defs")
    holder.append(defs)
    look = _look() if rich else None
    ports = {}
    # vertical bands (top → bottom): hepatocyte plate | Disse | endothelium | lumen | endothelium | Disse | hepatocyte plate
    hep_h = H * 0.26
    dis_h = H * 0.11 + fibrosis * H * 0.02
    end_h = 5.5 * s
    y_hep1 = hep_h
    y_dis1 = y_hep1 + dis_h
    y_lum0 = y_dis1 + end_h
    y_lum1 = H - hep_h - dis_h - end_h
    y_dis2 = y_lum1 + end_h
    y_hep2 = y_dis2 + dis_h
    hep_line = _mix(hepatocyte, "#5A2A1A", 0.45)
    # 1. native outline: whole tissue block (plates' colour); lumen etc. on top
    holder.append(
        _el(
            "rect",
            x=0,
            y=0,
            width=W,
            height=H,
            rx=10 * s,
            fill=_mix(hepatocyte, "#FFFFFF", 0.2),
            stroke=hep_line,
            stroke_width=1.1 * s,
            data_outline="1",
        )
    )
    # 2. Disse spaces (pale, with microvilli) and lumen
    disse_c = "#F7F1E6"
    for y0 in (y_hep1, y_dis2):
        holder.append(_el("rect", x=0, y=y0, width=W, height=dis_h, fill=disse_c))
    lumen_c = _mix(blood, "#FFFFFF", 0.86)
    holder.append(_el("rect", x=0, y=y_lum0, width=W, height=y_lum1 - y_lum0, fill=lumen_c))
    # 3. hepatocyte plates: polygonal cells with nuclei; bile canaliculi between neighbours
    cw = W / cells
    hep_d, nuc_d, bc_d, mv = [], [], [], []
    for row, (y0, y1, face) in enumerate(((0, y_hep1, y_hep1), (y_hep2, H, y_hep2))):
        off = cw * 0.5 * row
        xs = [0] + [off + cw * k + rnd.uniform(-0.08, 0.08) * cw for k in range(1, cells + (1 if row else 0))] + [W]
        xs = sorted(x for x in xs if 0 <= x <= W)
        for a, b in zip(xs, xs[1:]):
            if b - a < cw * 0.3:
                continue
            g = 2.2 * s
            top, bot = (g, y1 - g) if row == 0 else (y0 + g, H - g)
            pts = [(a + g, top), (b - g, top), (b - g, bot), (a + g, bot)]
            hep_d.append("M" + " L".join(f"{fmt(x)} {fmt(y)}" for x, y in pts) + " Z")
            cx, cy = (a + b) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2 + (-hep_h * 0.08 if row == 0 else hep_h * 0.08)
            r = min(b - a, y1 - y0) * 0.17
            nuc_d.append(_circ(cx, cy, r))
            if b < W - 1:
                bc_y = (y0 + y1) / 2 + (hep_h * 0.22 if row == 0 else -hep_h * 0.22)
                bc_d.append(_circ(b, bc_y, 3.2 * s))
            # microvilli of the sinusoidal face into the Disse space
            n_mv = max(3, int((b - a) / (7 * s)))
            for k in range(n_mv):
                x = a + (b - a) * (k + 0.5) / n_mv
                mv.append(f"M{fmt(x)} {fmt(face)} L{fmt(x)} {fmt(face + (1 if row == 0 else -1) * dis_h * 0.45)}")
            ports.setdefault(
                "hepatocyte" if row == 0 else "hepatocyte2", (cx, cy - r * 1.8 if row == 0 else cy + r * 1.8)
            )
    holder.append(
        _el("path", d=" ".join(hep_d), fill=hepatocyte, stroke=hep_line, stroke_width=1 * s, stroke_linejoin="round")
    )
    holder.append(
        _el(
            "path",
            d=" ".join(mv),
            fill="none",
            stroke=_mix(hepatocyte, "#5A2A1A", 0.25),
            stroke_width=1.5 * s,
            stroke_linecap="round",
        )
    )
    holder.append(
        _el(
            "path",
            d=" ".join(nuc_d),
            fill=_mix(hepatocyte, "#5A3A7A", 0.45),
            stroke=_mix(hepatocyte, "#3A1A3A", 0.5),
            stroke_width=0.9 * s,
        )
    )
    holder.append(_el("path", d=" ".join(bc_d), fill="#E8D25A", stroke="#8A7420", stroke_width=0.8 * s))
    if bc_d:
        bx = float(bc_d[0].split()[0][1:]) - 3.2 * s
        ports["bile_canaliculus"] = (bx, (0 + y_hep1) / 2 + hep_h * 0.22)
    # 4. collagen in the Disse space (fibrosis) + basement membrane (capillarisation)
    if fibrosis > 0:
        for y0 in (y_hep1, y_dis2):
            k = 1 + int(fibrosis * 3)
            for j in range(k):
                x0 = W * (0.04 + 0.9 * j / k) + rnd.uniform(0, W * 0.05)
                x1 = min(W * 0.98, x0 + W * (0.18 + 0.25 * fibrosis))
                holder.append(
                    _fibre_bundle(
                        x0,
                        y0 + dis_h * 0.5,
                        x1,
                        y0 + dis_h * 0.5 + rnd.uniform(-1, 1) * dis_h * 0.1,
                        dis_h * 0.5,
                        _COLLAGEN,
                        3,
                        1.1 * s,
                    )
                )
        ports["collagen"] = (W * 0.3, y_dis2 + dis_h * 0.5)
        if fibrosis >= 0.5:
            for y in (y_dis1 - 1.2 * s, y_dis2 + 1.2 * s):
                holder.append(
                    _el(
                        "path", d=f"M0 {fmt(y)} L{fmt(W)} {fmt(y)}", fill="none", stroke="#7A6A9A", stroke_width=1.6 * s
                    )
                )
    # 5. fenestrated endothelium: thin cells with gaps (fenestrae), flattened nuclei bulging into the lumen
    n_fen = int(round(7 * (1 - fibrosis)))
    end_d, fen = [], []
    for y0 in (y_dis1, y_lum1):
        gaps = sorted(W * (k + 0.5 + rnd.uniform(-0.2, 0.2)) / max(1, n_fen) for k in range(n_fen))
        x = 0.0
        gw = 6 * s
        for gx in gaps + [W + gw]:
            if gx - gw / 2 > x:
                end_d.append(
                    f"M{fmt(x)} {fmt(y0)} L{fmt(min(W, gx - gw / 2))} {fmt(y0)} L{fmt(min(W, gx - gw / 2))} {fmt(y0 + end_h)} "
                    f"L{fmt(x)} {fmt(y0 + end_h)} Z"
                )
            if gx < W:
                fen.append((gx, y0 + end_h / 2))
            x = gx + gw / 2
    holder.append(
        _el("path", d=" ".join(end_d), fill=endothelium, stroke=_mix(endothelium, "#000000", 0.3), stroke_width=0.6 * s)
    )
    en_nuc = []
    for x, y0, sgn in ((W * 0.22, y_lum0, 1), (W * 0.7, y_lum0, 1), (W * 0.45, y_lum1, -1), (W * 0.88, y_lum1, -1)):
        en_nuc.append(_ellipse_d(x, y0 + sgn * 3.5 * s, 16 * s, 4.5 * s))
    holder.append(
        _el(
            "path",
            d=" ".join(en_nuc),
            fill=_mix(endothelium, "#4A2A5A", 0.45),
            stroke=_mix(endothelium, "#000000", 0.4),
            stroke_width=0.6 * s,
        )
    )
    ports["endothelium"] = (W * 0.58, y_lum0 + 1)
    if fen:
        ports["fenestra"] = fen[len(fen) // 4] if len(fen) > 3 else fen[0]
    # 6. red blood cells flowing in the lumen
    from ._bio_parts import _rbc_items, _rbc_gradient

    rbcs = []
    lum_mid, lum_h = (y_lum0 + y_lum1) / 2, y_lum1 - y_lum0
    xs_r = [W * f for f in (0.08, 0.3, 0.42, 0.58, 0.8, 0.93)]
    for k, x in enumerate(xs_r):
        y = lum_mid + (lum_h * 0.22 if k % 2 else -lum_h * 0.2)
        rbcs.append(("face" if k % 3 else "side", x, y, lum_h * 0.17, rnd.uniform(-25, 25)))
        ports[f"rbc{k}"] = (x, y)
    if rich:
        defs.append(_rbc_gradient(blood, gid="lsrbc"))
    nat, lk = _rbc_items(rbcs, blood, rich, gid="lsrbc")
    holder.extend(nat)
    if rich:
        look.extend(lk)
    # 7. Kupffer cell: macrophage clinging to the endothelium, with phagosomes
    if kupffer:
        kx, ky = W * 0.18, y_lum0 + lum_h * 0.32
        kr = lum_h * 0.26
        kp = []
        for i in range(60):
            a = 2 * math.pi * i / 60
            kk = 1 + 0.1 * math.sin(5 * a + 1) + 0.06 * math.sin(9 * a)
            kp.append((kx + kr * 1.35 * kk * math.cos(a), ky + kr * 0.8 * kk * math.sin(a)))
        kc = "#D7C6E6"
        holder.append(_el("path", d=_smooth(kp, closed=True), fill=kc, stroke="#6A4A8A", stroke_width=1.1 * s))
        bean = [
            (
                kx - kr * 0.2 + kr * 0.5 * (1 - 0.4 * math.exp(-(((a - math.pi) / 0.6) ** 2))) * math.cos(a),
                ky + kr * 0.3 * (1 - 0.4 * math.exp(-(((a - math.pi) / 0.6) ** 2))) * math.sin(a),
            )
            for a in (2 * math.pi * i / 36 for i in range(36))
        ]
        holder.append(_el("path", d=_smooth(bean, closed=True), fill="#9A80BA", stroke="#5A3A7A", stroke_width=0.8 * s))
        holder.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=_circ(kx + kr * 0.62, ky - kr * 0.1, kr * 0.22)
                + " "
                + _circ(kx + kr * 0.3, ky + kr * 0.42, kr * 0.14),
                fill="#F4EEF8",
                stroke="#6A4A8A",
                stroke_width=0.8 * s,
            )
        )
        ports["kupffer"] = (kx, ky - kr * 0.55)
    # 8. hepatic stellate cell in the lower Disse space
    act = stellate == "activated"
    sx, sy = W * 0.62, y_dis2 + dis_h * 0.5
    srx = W * (0.12 if act else 0.075)
    sry = dis_h * (0.42 if act else 0.95)
    els, slook, pts, sp = _stellate_parts(
        sx,
        sy,
        srx,
        sry,
        activated=act,
        fill=stellate_color,
        membrane="#8A7A3A",
        rich=rich,
        seed=seed,
        band=None if act else dis_h / 2,
    )
    holder.extend(els)
    if rich:
        look.extend(slook)
    ports["stellate"] = (sx, sy)
    if act:
        ports.setdefault("collagen", sp.get("collagen"))
    else:
        ports["lipid"] = sp["lipid"]
    if rich:
        defs.append(_radial("lsh", "#FFFFFF", "#5A2A1A", fx=0.4, fy=0.3))
        g0 = defs[-1]
        g0[0].set("stop-opacity", ".15")
        g0[1].set("stop-opacity", ".12")
        look.insert(0, _el("rect", x=0, y=0, width=W, height=H, rx=10 * s, fill="url(#lsh)"))
        look.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=" ".join(
                    f"M{fmt(W * a)} {fmt(lum_mid + d)} L{fmt(W * b)} {fmt(lum_mid + d)}"
                    for a, b, d in ((0.33, 0.4, -lum_h * 0.02), (0.66, 0.74, lum_h * 0.05))
                ),
                stroke="#FFFFFF",
                stroke_width=2 * s,
                stroke_opacity=0.7,
                stroke_linecap="round",
            )
        )
        holder.append(look)
    ports.update(
        lumen=(W * 0.5, lum_mid), disse=(W * 0.3, y_hep1 + dis_h * 0.5), inflow=(0, lum_mid), outflow=(W, lum_mid)
    )
    return _finish(holder, defs, Box(0, 0, W, H), **ports)

Redesigned to match `final_svg_relation/03_BL_bloom/step1_reference/bloom_hero_reference.svg`.

    * n_tiers ∈ [3, 7]

API:

def _try_skin_draw(kind: str, x: float, y: float, w: float, h: float, label: str, palette, **kwargs):
    skin_mod = _get_active_skin()
    if skin_mod is None:
        return None
    skin_inst = getattr(skin_mod, "SKIN_INSTANCE", None)
    if skin_inst is None:
        return None
    draw_fn = getattr(skin_inst, "draw_node", None)
    if draw_fn is None:
        return None
    try:
        return draw_fn(x, y, w, h, label, palette, kind=kind, **kwargs)
    except Exception:
        return None

def build_bloom_tree(
    tiers: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    *,
    kicker: str = "§ BLOOM · COGNITIVE LADDER · ANDERSON 2001 REVISED",
    figure_title: str = "Bloom 认知阶梯 · Senior ML engineer 培养路径 6 层全景",
    figure_caption: str = (
        "Anderson 2001 revised · L1 记忆 → Ln 创造 · higher-order cognitive demand 上升 · 每层附动词族与真实任务范例"
    ),
    source: str = ("L&D curriculum · Sept 2026 · cohort n=48 · quarterly assessment · Anderson 2001 revised taxonomy"),
    reading: str = ('从底 L1 记忆 → 顶 L6 创造 · 每上一层认知复杂度递增 · 宽度收敛象征"能独立完成的人越来越少"'),
    fig_ref: str = "",
    kpis: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]] = None,
    callout: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    legend: Optional[List[Tuple[str, str, str]]] = None,
    how_to_read: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    has_sidebar: bool = True,
    axis_label: str = "HIGHER-ORDER  COGNITIVE  DEMAND",
    axis_top_tag: str = "CREATE",
    axis_bot_tag: str = "REMEMBER",
    encoding_note: Optional[str] = None,
    show_legend: bool = False,
) -> Tree:
    """Build a Bloom Tree.

    tiers : list of (cn, en, verbs, example, hue, mastery_pct)
        - 3-item form: (cn, verbs, hue) · en/example/pct default empty
        - 4-item form: (cn, en, verbs, example) · hue picks from cycle, no pct
        - 5-item form: (cn, en, verbs, example, hue) · pct=None
        - 6-item form: full
      tiers[0] = L1 (bottom, widest); tiers[-1] = Ln (top, narrowest).
    kpis : list of {kicker, value, note, hue} · [] disables the band · None uses baseline
    callout : {"tier_num": int, "kicker": str, "text": str, "hue": str, "enabled": bool}
        None = auto-detect max-drop tier · {"enabled": False} = hide
    legend : list of (kind, hue, label) · kind ∈ {rect_tint, bar, callout, dashed}
    how_to_read : list[str] · sidebar bottom mini panel
    has_sidebar : bool · False hides sidebar and expands pyramid rightward
    """
    src = tiers if tiers is not None else BASELINE_TIERS
    # if user passed baseline tiers (or nothing) and no callout override,
    # default to reference-aligned BASELINE_CALLOUT so hero baseline matches
    # step1 SVG exactly. When user passes custom tiers → auto-detect max drop.
    if callout is None and tiers is None:
        callout = dict(BASELINE_CALLOUT)
    _fallback_hues = ["blue", "green", "gold_p", "orange", "magenta", "olive", "cinnamon"]

    root = TreeNode(
        id="bloom",
        label="BLOOM",
        extra={
            "kpis": kpis if kpis is not None else BASELINE_KPIS,
            "callout": callout,  # None → layout will auto-compute
            "legend": legend if legend is not None else BASELINE_LEGEND,
            # Round-1: HOW TO READ default OFF · redundant with pyramid/sidebar
            # encoding. Callers can pass how_to_read=[...] explicitly to opt in.
            "how_to_read": how_to_read if how_to_read is not None else [],
            "has_sidebar": has_sidebar,
            "reading": reading,
            "fig_ref": fig_ref,
            "axis_label": axis_label,
            "axis_top_tag": axis_top_tag,
            "axis_bot_tag": axis_bot_tag,
            # Round-1: bottom LEGEND default OFF (chart-chatter, duplicates
            # the pyramid's own hue-to-tier encoding). Set show_legend=True
            # via build_bloom_tree(show_legend=True) or on the tree.extra.
            "show_legend": show_legend,
        },
    )
    cur = root
    for i, t in enumerate(src):
        if not isinstance(t, (list, tuple)):
            raise ValueError(f"tier[{i}] must be tuple/list, got {type(t)}")
        if len(t) == 6:
            cn, en, verbs, example, hue, pct = t
        elif len(t) == 5:
            cn, en, verbs, example, hue = t
            pct = None
        elif len(t) == 4:
            cn, en, verbs, example = t
            hue = _fallback_hues[i % len(_fallback_hues)]
            pct = None
        elif len(t) == 3:
            cn, verbs, hue = t
            en, example, pct = "", "", None
        elif len(t) == 2:
            cn, verbs = t
            en, example, pct = "", "", None
            hue = _fallback_hues[i % len(_fallback_hues)]
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"tier[{i}] must be 2/3/4/5/6-tuple, got {len(t)}")
        node = TreeNode(
            id=f"BL{i + 1}",
            label=str(cn),
            sublabel=str(en),
            detail=str(verbs),
            group=str(hue),
            extra={
                "example": str(example) if example else "",
                "mastery_pct": pct,
                "tier_num": i + 1,
            },
        )
        cur.children.append(node)
        cur = node

    if encoding_note is None:
        encoding_note = f"{len(src)} tier · Anderson 2001 revised · L1→L{len(src)}"
    tree = Tree(
        root=root,
        kicker=kicker,
        figure_title=figure_title,
        figure_caption=figure_caption,
        source=source,
        encoding_note=encoding_note,
    )
    # expose extra at Tree level for layout convenience
    setattr(tree, "extra", dict(root.extra))
    return tree

def _hue_dandelion(name: str) -> str:
    """Legacy dandelion accent — retained for backward compat. New code should
    route CALLOUT through palette.accent (see _callout_fill) so skin/palette
    changes actually reach the callout."""
    return _DANDELION_HUE.get(name, _DANDELION_HUE["cinnamon"])


def _hue(name: str) -> str:
    """Return palette hue (# hex or rgba) if present in current HUE (rebuilt by
    _apply_skin_palette), else fall back to dandelion accent. Previous version
    required '#'-prefix which threw all rgba() palettes back into dandelion —
    that was the "palette not swapping" bug in Round-1 audit."""
    c = HUE.get(name)
    if c:
        return c
    return _DANDELION_HUE.get(name, _DANDELION_HUE["cinnamon"])


def _callout_fill(pal) -> str:
    """Callout background · uses palette.accent (or .primary fallback) so the
    CLIFF callout adopts the current skin/palette instead of the hard-coded
    dandelion cinnamon `rgba(168,88,42,1)`. Round-1 audit issue B fix."""
    if pal is None:
        return _DANDELION_HUE["cinnamon"]
    for attr in ("accent", "primary", "ink"):
        v = getattr(pal, attr, None)
        if v:
            return v
    return _DANDELION_HUE["cinnamon"]


def _hue_rgba(name: str, alpha: float = 1.0) -> str:
    c = _hue(name)
    if c.startswith("#"):
        h = c.lstrip("#")
        r, g, b = int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
        return f"rgba({r},{g},{b},{alpha:.2f})"
    if c.startswith("rgba"):
        import re

        m = re.match(r"rgba\((\d+),(\d+),(\d+),[\d.]+\)", c)
        if m:
            return f"rgba({m.group(1)},{m.group(2)},{m.group(3)},{alpha:.2f})"
    return c


def _rgb_triplet(color: str) -> Optional[Tuple[int, int, int]]:
    if not color:
        return None
    c = color.strip()
    if c.startswith("#") and len(c) == 7:
        h = c[1:]
        try:
            return int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    import re

    m = re.match(r"rgba?\((\d+),(\d+),(\d+)", c)
    if m:
        return int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
    return None


def _with_alpha(color: str, alpha: float) -> str:
    rgb = _rgb_triplet(color)
    if rgb is None:
        return color
    return f"rgba({rgb[0]},{rgb[1]},{rgb[2]},{alpha:.2f})"


def _luma(color: str) -> float:
    rgb = _rgb_triplet(color)
    if rgb is None:
        return 0.0
    r, g, b = rgb
    return 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b


def _hue_visual(name: str, pal=None) -> str:
    """Return a hue safe for strokes and text on light slide backgrounds."""
    c = _hue(name)
    if _luma(c) >= 205.0:
        for attr in ("primary", "accent", "ink"):
            v = getattr(pal, attr, None) if pal is not None else None
            if v and _luma(v) < 160.0:
                return v
        return MUTE_INK
    return c

# Bucket H (2026-09-13) · subtract_level 默认预设 · L3 = 极简 (默认)
_SUBTRACT_L0: List[str] = []
_SUBTRACT_L1: List[str] = ["tier_shadow", "layout_meta", "axis_dot"]
_SUBTRACT_L2: List[str] = _SUBTRACT_L1 + ["axis_label", "callout_kicker"]
_SUBTRACT_L3: List[str] = _SUBTRACT_L2 + [
    "tier_example",
    "tier_bar_bg",
    "tier_bar_fill",
    "tier_pct",
    "callout_rect",
    "callout_line",

def _resolve_skip_kinds(skip_kinds: Optional[List[str]], subtract_level: str) -> set:
    if skip_kinds is not None:
        return set(skip_kinds)
    return set(_SUBTRACT_MAP.get(subtract_level, _SUBTRACT_L3))


def render_hero_embed_bl_bloom_v2(
    data: Tree = None,
    palette: Palette = None,
    params: Optional[BloomParams] = None,
    *,
    subtract_level: str = "L3",
    skip_kinds: Optional[List[str]] = None,
) -> str:
    """Render Bloom stepped pyramid · viewBox 1400×720."""
    # [FONT-PATCH-L1] font pass-through (standalone): ea.FONT_SANS/SERIF 覆写
    _MOD_FONT = globals()
    _ORIG_FONT = {k: _MOD_FONT[k] for k in ("FONT_SANS", "FONT_SERIF") if k in _MOD_FONT}
    # [INK-PATCH-L1] skin-aware ink/gray
    _MOD_INK = globals()
    _ORIG_INK = {k: _MOD_INK[k] for k in ("MUTE_INK",) if k in _MOD_INK}
    try:
        from ..skins._base import _hex_to_rgba as _hex2rgba_ink

        _sk_ink = _get_active_skin()
        if _sk_ink is not None:
            _sp_ink = getattr(_sk_ink, "PALETTE", None)
            if _sp_ink is not None and getattr(_sp_ink, "ink", None):
                if "MUTE_INK" in _MOD_INK:
                    _MOD_INK["MUTE_INK"] = _hex2rgba_ink(_sp_ink.ink, 1.0)
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from ..skins import editorial_atelier as _ea_font

        if "FONT_SANS" in _MOD_FONT and _ea_font.FONT_SANS != _MOD_FONT["FONT_SANS"]:
            _MOD_FONT["FONT_SANS"] = _ea_font.FONT_SANS
        if "FONT_SERIF" in _MOD_FONT and _ea_font.FONT_SERIF != _MOD_FONT["FONT_SERIF"]:
            _MOD_FONT["FONT_SERIF"] = _ea_font.FONT_SERIF
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        if data is None:
            data = HERO_BL_DATA
        pal = palette or BONE_RUST
        p = params or BloomParams()

        root = getattr(data, "root", None)
        if root is None:
            raise LayoutOverflow("bloom: no root")
        root_extra = getattr(root, "extra", {}) or {}
        kpis = root_extra.get("kpis", []) or []
        legend_items = root_extra.get("legend", []) or []
        how_to_read = root_extra.get("how_to_read", []) or []
        has_sidebar = bool(root_extra.get("has_sidebar", True))
        reading = str(root_extra.get("reading", "") or "")
        fig_ref = str(root_extra.get("fig_ref", "") or "")

        # ensure tree.extra reflects root.extra for layout
        if not hasattr(data, "extra") or not getattr(data, "extra", None):
            setattr(data, "extra", dict(root_extra))
        else:
            # merge (root_extra wins for structural keys)
            tree_extra = dict(data.extra)
            for k in ("callout", "axis_label", "axis_top_tag", "axis_bot_tag"):
                if k in root_extra:
                    tree_extra[k] = root_extra[k]
            setattr(data, "extra", tree_extra)

        # Bucket H · subtraction filter
        _skips = _resolve_skip_kinds(skip_kinds, subtract_level)
        render_sidebar = has_sidebar and "layout_meta" not in _skips
        raw_positions = bloom_v2_layout(data, params=p, has_sidebar=render_sidebar, has_kpi_band=bool(kpis))
        raw_layout_meta = next(
            (pos for pos in raw_positions if pos.get("kind") == "layout_meta"),
            {},
        )
        positions = raw_positions
        if _skips:
            positions = [pos for pos in positions if pos.get("kind") not in _skips]
        has_visible_right_detail = any(
            pos.get("kind") in {"tier_example", "tier_bar_bg", "tier_bar_fill", "tier_pct"} for pos in positions
        )
        show_kpi_notes = bool(root_extra.get("show_kpi_notes", False))

        parts: List[str] = [
            f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {VIEW_W} {VIEW_H}">',
        ]
        # paper bg
        parts.append(f'<rect x="0" y="0" width="{VIEW_W}" height="{VIEW_H}" fill="{pal.bg}"/>')

        # ── HEADER · kicker + title + caption + hairline ──
        # Round-1 fix: all body-tier text bumped to ≥15pt in SVG-space so that
        # after atomize scaling (900/1342 ≈ 0.67), on-slide font-size stays
        # ≥10pt hard red line.
        if getattr(data, "kicker", ""):
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="70" y="42" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" '
                f'font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}" letter-spacing="0.26em">'
                f"{esc(data.kicker)}</text>"
            )
        parts.append(
            f'<text x="70" y="76" font-family="{FONT_SERIF}" font-size="26" '
            f'font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_INK}" letter-spacing="0.02em">'
            f"{esc(data.figure_title)}</text>"
        )
        # subtitle · only render when caption exists AND differs from title.
        _sub_txt = (getattr(data, "figure_caption", "") or "").strip()
        _title_txt = (getattr(data, "figure_title", "") or "").strip()
        if _sub_txt and _sub_txt != _title_txt:
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="70" y="100" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" '
                f'fill="{MUTE_DIM}" letter-spacing="0.02em">'
                f"{esc(_sub_txt)}</text>"
            )
        parts.append(f'<line x1="70" y1="118" x2="1330" y2="118" stroke="{MUTE_INK}" stroke-width="0.8"/>')

        # ── KPI BADGES BAND (optional) ──
        # Round-1: kicker 8.5→15, note 10→15 so slide-space ≥10pt. Row heights
        # slightly bumped (34→46) to hold the enlarged 3-row content.
        if kpis:
            kpi_y = 132
            kpi_h = 46
            kpi_gap = 20
            n_show = min(len(kpis), 4)
            kpi_left = 70.0
            kpi_right = float(raw_layout_meta.get("x_right", 1040.0) or 1040.0)
            kpi_w = max(180.0, (kpi_right - kpi_left - (n_show - 1) * kpi_gap) / n_show)
            for i in range(n_show):
                k = kpis[i]
                kx = kpi_left + i * (kpi_w + kpi_gap)
                hue = k.get("hue", "blue")
                c = _hue_visual(hue, pal)
                parts.append(
                    f'<rect x="{kx}" y="{kpi_y}" width="{kpi_w}" height="{kpi_h}" '
                    f'fill="{BADGE_BG}" stroke="{BADGE_STROKE}" stroke-width="0.6"/>'
                )
                parts.append(f'<rect x="{kx}" y="{kpi_y}" width="4" height="{kpi_h}" fill="{c}"/>')
                note = k.get("note")
                note_str = str(note) if note else ""
                value_str = str(k.get("value", ""))
                value_x = kx + 14
                kicker_full_w = kpi_w - 24.0
                kicker_str = str(k.get("kicker", "")).upper()
                kicker_tl = ""
                # kicker now 15pt tracked 0.16em → ~3.4px/char
                if len(kicker_str) * 3.4 > kicker_full_w:
                    kicker_tl = f' textLength="{kicker_full_w:.1f}" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"'
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{value_x}" y="{kpi_y + 18}" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" '
                    f'font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}" '
                    f'letter-spacing="0.16em"{kicker_tl}>{esc(kicker_str)}</text>'
                )
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{value_x}" y="{kpi_y + 38}" font-family="{FONT_SERIF}" '
                    f'font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_INK}">'
                    f"{esc(value_str)}</text>"
                )
                if show_kpi_notes and note_str:
                    value_w = max(24.0, len(value_str) * 12.0)
                    note_right = kx + kpi_w - 10
                    note_left_min = value_x + value_w + 12.0
                    note_available_w = max(20.0, note_right - note_left_min)
                    approx_w = 8.4 * len(note_str)
                    note_tl = ""
                    note_fs = 15.0
                    if approx_w > note_available_w:
                        note_tl = f' textLength="{note_available_w:.1f}" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"'
                    parts.append(
                        f'<text x="{note_right}" y="{kpi_y + 38}" text-anchor="end" '
                        f'font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="{note_fs:.1f}" '
                        f'fill="{MUTE_SLATE}"{note_tl}>{esc(note_str)}</text>'
                    )

        # ── AXIS (rotated left rail) ──
        # Round-1 fix: axis removed. rotate(-90) label survives atomize as a
        # horizontal 6pt sliver at x=4 (illegible after scale ≈0.67). Layout
        # still emits axis_* positions but preset ignores them; pyramid gets
        # left-margin bonus for larger tier CN glyphs.
        # (axis_line / axis_arrow / axis_dot / axis_label / axis_top_tag /
        #  axis_bot_tag are all skipped intentionally.)

        # ── TIER shadows first (drawn before rects) ──
        for pos in positions:
            if pos["kind"] == "tier_shadow":
                parts.append(
                    f'<rect x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                    f'width="{pos["w"]:.1f}" height="{pos["h"]:.1f}" '
                    f'fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.05)"/>'
                )

        # ── TIER RECTS · hue-tinted with hue stroke ──
        for pos in positions:
            if pos["kind"] == "tier_rect":
                c = _hue_visual(pos["hue"], pal)
                skin_svg = _try_skin_draw(
                    "bloom_tier_rect",
                    pos["x"],
                    pos["y"],
                    pos["w"],
                    pos["h"],
                    "",
                    pal,
                    hue=pos["hue"],
                    hue_color=c,
                )
                if skin_svg:
                    parts.append(skin_svg)
                else:
                    parts.append(
                        f'<rect x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                        f'width="{pos["w"]:.1f}" height="{pos["h"]:.1f}" '
                        f'fill="{_with_alpha(c, 0.16)}" '
                        f'stroke="{_with_alpha(c, 0.95)}" stroke-width="1.4"/>'
                    )
            elif pos["kind"] == "tier_hue_bar":
                c = _hue_visual(pos["hue"], pal)
                parts.append(
                    f'<rect x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                    f'width="{pos["w"]:.1f}" height="{pos["h"]:.1f}" fill="{c}"/>'
                )
            elif pos["kind"] == "tier_guide_line" and not has_visible_right_detail:
                c = _hue_visual(pos["hue"], pal)
                parts.append(
                    f'<line x1="{pos["x1"]:.1f}" y1="{pos["y1"]:.1f}" '
                    f'x2="{pos["x2"]:.1f}" y2="{pos["y2"]:.1f}" '
                    f'stroke="{_with_alpha(c, 0.42)}" stroke-width="1.6"/>'
                )

        # ── TIER TEXT layer ──
        # Round-1: all body-tier text bumped to ≥15pt in SVG-space so on-slide
        # rendered pt (≈svg_pt × 0.67) stays ≥10pt hard red line.
        for pos in positions:
            k = pos["kind"]
            if k == "tier_id":
                c = _hue_visual(pos["hue"], pal)
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" font-weight="700" '
                    f'fill="{c}" letter-spacing="0.18em">{esc(pos["text"])}</text>'
                )
            elif k == "tier_cn":
                fs = float(pos.get("font_size", 24.0))
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SERIF}" font-size="{fs}" font-weight="700" '
                    f'fill="{MUTE_INK}">{esc(pos["text"])}</text>'
                )
            elif k == "tier_en":
                c = _hue_visual(pos["hue"], pal)
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="16" font-weight="700" '
                    f'fill="{c}" letter-spacing="0.18em">{esc(pos["text"])}</text>'
                )
            elif k == "tier_verbs":
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" font-style="italic" '
                    f'fill="{MUTE_SLATE}">{esc(pos["text"])}</text>'
                )
            elif k == "tier_example":
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" text-anchor="end" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" font-weight="600" '
                    f'fill="{MUTE_INK}">{esc(pos["text"])}</text>'
                )
            elif k == "tier_bar_bg":
                c = _hue_visual(pos["hue"], pal)
                parts.append(
                    f'<rect x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                    f'width="{pos["w"]:.1f}" height="{pos["h"]:.1f}" '
                    f'fill="{_with_alpha(c, 0.22)}"/>'
                )
            elif k == "tier_bar_fill":
                c = _hue_visual(pos["hue"], pal)
                parts.append(
                    f'<rect x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                    f'width="{pos["w"]:.1f}" height="{pos["h"]:.1f}" '
                    f'fill="{_with_alpha(c, 0.92)}"/>'
                )
            elif k == "tier_pct":
                c = _hue_visual(pos["hue"], pal)
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" text-anchor="end" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SERIF}" font-size="16" font-weight="700" '
                    f'fill="{c}">{esc(pos["text"])}</text>'
                )

        # ── CALLOUT ──
        for pos in positions:
            k = pos["kind"]
            if k == "callout_rect":
                # Round-1 fix: callout adopts palette.accent so skin/palette
                # changes propagate to the CLIFF callout (was hard-coded
                # cinnamon `rgba(168,88,42,1)` for every skin).
                c = _callout_fill(pal)
                parts.append(
                    f'<rect x="{pos["x"]:.1f}" y="{pos["y"]:.1f}" '
                    f'width="{pos["w"]:.1f}" height="{pos["h"]:.1f}" '
                    f'fill="{c}"/>'
                )
            elif k == "callout_kicker":
                fs = max(float(pos.get("font_size", 10.5)), 15.0)
                # constrain text within callout width: shrink glyphs via textLength
                tl = pos.get("text_length")
                length_attr = ""
                if tl is not None:
                    length_attr = f' textLength="{tl:.1f}" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"'
                # letter-spacing from layout (drops from 0.22em to 0.06em when the
                # callout is narrow so "MASTERY CLIFF" still fits at 10.5pt)
                ls_em = pos.get("letter_spacing", 0.22)
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{pos["cx"]:.1f}" y="{pos["cy"]:.1f}" text-anchor="middle" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="{fs}" font-weight="700" '
                    f'fill="{pal.bg}" letter-spacing="{ls_em:.2f}em"{length_attr}>'
                    f"{esc(pos['text'])}</text>"
                )
            elif k == "callout_line":
                fs = max(float(pos.get("font_size", 13.0)), 16.0)
                tl = pos.get("text_length")
                length_attr = ""
                if tl is not None:
                    length_attr = f' textLength="{tl:.1f}" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"'
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{pos["cx"]:.1f}" y="{pos["cy"]:.1f}" text-anchor="middle" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SERIF}" font-size="{fs}" font-weight="700" '
                    f'font-style="italic" fill="{pal.bg}"{length_attr}>'
                    f"{esc(pos['text'])}</text>"
                )

        # ── RIGHT SIDEBAR (optional) ──
        layout_meta = next((pos for pos in positions if pos["kind"] == "layout_meta"), None)
        if has_sidebar and layout_meta:
            tier_list = layout_meta.get("tiers", [])
            # sidebar column x
            sb_x = layout_meta.get("sidebar_x", 1140)
            sb_w = layout_meta.get("sidebar_w", 190)
            sb_right = sb_x + sb_w

            # ─ TIER MASTERY panel · rows from top-tier (Ln) down to L1
            # rename to "TIER PALETTE" when no pct data (test3 minimal) so the
            # label stays honest.
            panel_y = 200
            _panel_title = "TIER MASTERY" if any(t.get("pct") is not None for t in tier_list) else "TIER PALETTE"
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="{sb_x}" y="{panel_y}" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" '
                f'font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}" letter-spacing="0.18em">'
                f"{esc(_panel_title)}</text>"
            )
            parts.append(
                f'<line x1="{sb_x}" y1="{panel_y + 10}" x2="{sb_right}" y2="{panel_y + 10}" '
                f'stroke="{MUTE_INK}" stroke-width="0.6"/>'
            )
            row_h = 30
            # display top-tier first (Ln), descend to L1
            rev = list(reversed(tier_list))
            # detect whether ANY tier has pct data · when none, hide the bar/pct
            # column entirely so the sidebar row is just "L{n} · {cn}" (no faint
            # dead bars, no dash column). Fixes minimal-mode noise (test3).
            _sb_has_any_pct = any(t.get("pct") is not None for t in rev)
            for i, t in enumerate(rev):
                ry = panel_y + 22 + i * row_h
                hue = t.get("hue", "rust")
                c = _hue(hue)
                pct = t.get("pct")
                cn = t.get("cn", "")
                tn = t.get("tier_num", 0)
                label = f"L{tn} · {cn}" if cn else f"L{tn}"
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{sb_x}" y="{ry}" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" '
                    f'font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_INK}" letter-spacing="0.06em">'
                    f"{esc(label)}</text>"
                )
                if not _sb_has_any_pct:
                    # add a small hue swatch instead of bar so column isn't blank
                    sw_w = 40.0
                    sw_h = 10.0
                    sw_x = sb_right - sw_w
                    sw_y = ry - 8.0
                    parts.append(
                        f'<rect x="{sw_x:.1f}" y="{sw_y:.1f}" width="{sw_w:.1f}" '
                        f'height="{sw_h:.1f}" fill="{_hue_rgba(hue, 0.85)}"/>'
                    )
                    continue
                # bar (right-aligned block · 90 wide, ends at sb_right - 30)
                bar_w = 90.0
                bar_h = 10.0
                bar_right = sb_right - 30.0
                bar_x = bar_right - bar_w
                bar_y = ry - 8.0
                parts.append(
                    f'<rect x="{bar_x:.1f}" y="{bar_y:.1f}" width="{bar_w:.1f}" '
                    f'height="{bar_h:.1f}" fill="{_hue_rgba(hue, 0.22)}"/>'
                )
                if pct is not None:
                    pf = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(pct) / 100.0))
                    parts.append(
                        f'<rect x="{bar_x:.1f}" y="{bar_y:.1f}" '
                        f'width="{bar_w * pf:.1f}" height="{bar_h:.1f}" '
                        f'fill="{_hue_rgba(hue, 0.92)}"/>'
                    )
                pct_text = f"{int(round(pct))}%" if pct is not None else "—"
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{sb_right}" y="{ry + 0.5:.1f}" text-anchor="end" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SERIF}" font-size="16" font-weight="700" '
                    f'fill="{MUTE_INK}">{esc(pct_text)}</text>'
                )

            # ─ ACTION VERBS panel (Ln → L1)
            av_y = panel_y + 22 + len(rev) * row_h + 22
            # Guard against overflow into footer (footer starts ~640 after
            # Round-1 footer-move; keep sidebar body above 620)
            if av_y + len(rev) * 28 + 60 > 620:
                av_y = min(av_y, 620 - len(rev) * 28 - 60)
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="{sb_x}" y="{av_y}" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" '
                f'font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}" letter-spacing="0.18em">'
                f"ACTION VERBS · 每层动词族</text>"
            )
            parts.append(
                f'<line x1="{sb_x}" y1="{av_y + 10}" x2="{sb_right}" y2="{av_y + 10}" '
                f'stroke="{MUTE_INK}" stroke-width="0.6"/>'
            )
            av_row_h = 28
            for i, t in enumerate(rev):
                ry = av_y + 22 + i * av_row_h
                hue = t.get("hue", "rust")
                c = _hue(hue)
                tn = t.get("tier_num", 0)
                # find verbs text (short form)
                verbs_short = ""
                en = t.get("en", "")
                parts.append(f'<rect x="{sb_x}" y="{ry - 16}" width="3" height="20" fill="{c}"/>')
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{sb_x + 10}" y="{ry}" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" '
                    f'font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_INK}" '
                    f'letter-spacing="0.06em">L{tn}</text>'
                )
            # Verbs short label · derive from tree (walking chain)
            chain_verbs: List[str] = []
            cur = root
            while True:
                kids = list(getattr(cur, "children", []) or [])
                if not kids:
                    break
                child = kids[0]
                chain_verbs.append(str(getattr(child, "detail", "") or ""))
                cur = child
            n_tiers = len(chain_verbs)
            for i, t in enumerate(rev):
                ry = av_y + 22 + i * av_row_h
                idx_in_chain = n_tiers - 1 - i
                if 0 <= idx_in_chain < n_tiers:
                    verbs_full = chain_verbs[idx_in_chain]
                else:
                    verbs_full = ""
                short = _short_verbs(verbs_full, max_chars=18)
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{sb_x + 44}" y="{ry}" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" '
                    f'font-size="15" font-style="italic" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}">'
                    f"{esc(short)}</text>"
                )

            # ─ HOW TO READ mini panel (opt-in only)
            # Round-1: default hidden. how_to_read + LEGEND are redundant
            # chart-chatter. Sidebar already shows TIER MASTERY + ACTION VERBS
            # which explain the encoding by example. HOW TO READ only renders
            # when caller explicitly passes a non-empty list AND ACTION VERBS
            # doesn't already exceed vertical budget.
            htr_y = av_y + 22 + len(rev) * av_row_h + 24
            if how_to_read and htr_y + 60 < 640:
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{sb_x}" y="{htr_y}" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" '
                    f'font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}" '
                    f'letter-spacing="0.18em">HOW TO READ</text>'
                )
                parts.append(
                    f'<line x1="{sb_x}" y1="{htr_y + 10}" x2="{sb_right}" '
                    f'y2="{htr_y + 10}" stroke="{MUTE_INK}" stroke-width="0.6"/>'
                )
                for i, line in enumerate(how_to_read[:3]):
                    parts.append(
                        f'<text x="{sb_x}" y="{htr_y + 30 + i * 20}" '
                        f'font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" fill="{MUTE_DIM}">'
                        f"{esc(line)}</text>"
                    )

        # ── LEGEND (bottom left, above footer hairline) ──
        # Round-1: default HIDDEN. LEGEND was a redundant re-explanation of the
        # tier rect + progress bar + callout encoding that already lives in the
        # pyramid itself. Only render when caller passes a non-empty legend AND
        # opts in via an implicit non-baseline (i.e. legend still gets built by
        # baseline default, so we now also gate on `show_legend` flag that
        # defaults False; callers can flip it).
        has_any_pct = any(pos["kind"] == "tier_bar_fill" for pos in positions)
        has_callout = any(pos["kind"] == "callout_rect" for pos in positions)
        show_legend = bool(root_extra.get("show_legend", False))
        if legend_items and show_legend:
            filtered_legend: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = []
            for kind, hue, label in legend_items:
                if kind == "bar" and not has_any_pct:
                    continue
                if kind == "callout" and not has_callout:
                    continue
                filtered_legend.append((kind, hue, label))
        else:
            filtered_legend = []

        if filtered_legend:
            leg_y = 605
            cursor_x = 90.0
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="{cursor_x}" y="{leg_y}" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" '
                f'font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}" '
                f'letter-spacing="0.2em">LEGEND</text>'
            )
            cursor_x = 190.0
            for kind, hue, label in filtered_legend[:4]:
                c = _hue(hue)
                swatch_y = leg_y - 12
                if kind == "rect_tint":
                    parts.append(
                        f'<rect x="{cursor_x:.1f}" y="{swatch_y}" width="30" '
                        f'height="16" fill="{_hue_rgba(hue, 0.16)}" '
                        f'stroke="{_hue_rgba(hue, 0.95)}" stroke-width="1"/>'
                    )
                elif kind == "bar":
                    parts.append(
                        f'<rect x="{cursor_x:.1f}" y="{swatch_y}" width="30" '
                        f'height="16" fill="{_hue_rgba(hue, 0.92)}"/>'
                    )
                elif kind == "callout":
                    parts.append(f'<rect x="{cursor_x:.1f}" y="{swatch_y}" width="30" height="16" fill="{c}"/>')
                elif kind == "dashed":
                    parts.append(
                        f'<rect x="{cursor_x:.1f}" y="{swatch_y}" width="30" '
                        f'height="16" fill="{pal.bg}" stroke="{c}" stroke-width="1" '
                        f'stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>'
                    )
                parts.append(
                    f'<text x="{cursor_x + 38:.1f}" y="{leg_y}" '
                    f'font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" font-weight="600" '
                    f'fill="{MUTE_INK}">{esc(label)}</text>'
                )
                cursor_x += 38 + max(len(label) * 9.5, 160.0) + 40.0

        # ── FOOTER · source + reading + hairline ──
        # Round-1 fix: footer y=660/682/700 pushed content past atomize crop
        # (shrunk vb ended y≈691, on-slide ≈540 > 440 canvas). Move footer
        # into y=630/650/670 range so all rows land inside vb after shrink and
        # atomize to a 440-tall slide.
        parts.append(f'<line x1="70" y1="622" x2="1330" y2="622" stroke="{MUTE_INK}" stroke-width="0.5"/>')
        if getattr(data, "source", ""):
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="70" y="645" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" '
                f'font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}" letter-spacing="0.18em">'
                f"SOURCE</text>"
            )
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="160" y="645" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" '
                f'fill="{MUTE_DIM}">{esc(data.source)}</text>'
            )
        if reading:
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="70" y="672" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" '
                f'font-weight="700" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}" letter-spacing="0.18em">'
                f"READING</text>"
            )
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="160" y="672" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" font-size="15" '
                f'fill="{MUTE_DIM}">{esc(reading)}</text>'
            )
        if fig_ref:
            parts.append(
                f'<text x="1330" y="672" text-anchor="end" font-family="{FONT_SANS}" '
                f'font-size="15" font-style="italic" fill="{MUTE_SLATE}" '
                f'letter-spacing="0.06em">{esc(fig_ref)}</text>'
            )

        parts.append("</svg>")
        return "".join(parts)
    finally:
        try:
            _MOD_INK.update(_ORIG_INK)
        except Exception:
            pass
        _MOD_FONT.update(_ORIG_FONT)


def _short_verbs(text: str, max_chars: int = 20) -> str:
    """Trim verbs text · take first 2 tokens split on ' · ' or ' / '."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    # try ' · ' first
    for sep in [" · ", " / ", ", ", " "]:
        if sep in text:
            parts = [p_.strip() for p_ in text.split(sep) if p_.strip()]
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                out = f"{parts[0]} / {parts[1]}"
                if len(out) <= max_chars:
                    return out
                # fallback: just first
                if len(parts[0]) <= max_chars:
                    return parts[0]
                return parts[0][:max_chars]
    if len(text) <= max_chars:
        return text
    return text[:max_chars]
